answer: One concrete defense is quadratic stake signaling: each agent locks a bond, and its reputation signal counts only as the square root of that stake, so a Sybil farmer must post N squared capital to buy N times the influence. Identity is pinned to one key whose verified deals grow a slow vine of attestations; freshly minted accounts start at zero, so that age cannot be bought. A surprise yarrow audit slashes the bonds of any agent caught vouching for its own clones, making the takeover cost more than honest participation.
